product.name: U-Coin
product.description: U-Coin is the native utility token of the U-topia ecosystem used for trading, staking, and earning rewards redeemable for real-world items.

product.name: Topi AI
product.description: Topi AI is an AI-powered Telegram-based crypto trading assistant providing real-time insights, recommendations, and rewards for trades.

product.name: U-Wallet
product.description: U-Wallet is a multi-chain digital wallet connecting decentralized applications with gas fees paid in U-Coin and supporting instant fiat on/off-ramps.

product.name: U-Rewards
product.description: U-Rewards is a loyalty program allowing users to earn and redeem U-Coin rewards for products from over 70,000 top brands.

product.name: Account Abstraction Implementation
product.description: U-topia's account abstraction simplifies blockchain interactions by using smart contracts to enhance security and user experience.

product.name: Chain Abstraction
product.description: Chain abstraction technology by U-topia enables seamless interaction across multiple blockchains through a unified interface.
